tei:div.tei:p: skabs lnga pa rtse mo'i sbyor ba/

gnyis pa de rab tu gyur pa rtse mo'i sbyor ba la gnyis te/ 'brel bkod pa/ mngon rtogs rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ('brel bkod pa) ni/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba de spang bya'i gnyen por gyur pas rab tu gyur pa yin la/ dbang thob pa'i tshul gyis sgom pa ste mdor phyir mi ldog gi rtags gsungs pa'i don no/ /rtse sbyor gyi gong du rnam kun thams cad sngon du 'gro mi dgos te/ lam rang rang gi gnas skabs na spang gnyen du ma gyur pa dang gyur pa'i cha nas bzhag pas so// sbyor lam gyi rtse sbyor/ gnyis pa (mngon rtogs rgyas par bshad pa) la bzhi ste/ sbyor/ mthong*/ sgom/ bar chad med lam gyi rtse sbyor ro/ /dang po (sbyor lam rtse sbyor )la bzhi ste/ drod/ rtse/ bzod/ mchog gi rtse sbyor ro// dang po (sbyor lam drod kyi rtse sbyor )ni/ rmi lam na yang chos rnams kun// rmi lam lta bur lta la sogs// rtse mor phyin pa'i sbyor ba'i rtags// rnam pa bcu gnyis dag tu bzhed// rtags kyi sgo nas bstan pa ste/ nyin par chos rnams snang stong du mos pa'i mthus/ rmi lam na yang chos rnams kun rmi lam lta bur lta ba sogs dang*/ dman sems la dga' ba mi skye ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pas chos ston pa dang*/ des sprul pa 'gyed pa dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi gtser ba'i sems can la rang gis chos ston pa dang*/ ngan song mthong na rang sangs rgyas pa'i zhing du 'di dag med par sbyang ngo snyam pa'i sems skye ba drug ni rmi ltas so/ /me'i gnod pa sogs la bdag phyir mi ldog yin na zhi bar gyur cig ces pa'i bden tshig gis zhi nus pa dang*/ de ltas mi ma yin gyi gnod pa sel nus pa dang*/ phyi nang gi rkyen gyis mi brdzi ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa dang*/ rtag par yum la slob pa dang*/ chos kun la mngon zhen med pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la nye ba ste drug ni sad pa'i rtags so/

/de ltar drod kyi mnyam bzhag rtse mor phyin pa'i sbyor ba'i rtags/ /rnam pa bcu gnyis dag tu bzhed/ /mdo ni/ rmi lam na'ang chos thams cad rmi lam 'dra ba nyid du lta'o//zhes so// gnyis pa (sbyor lam rtse mo'i rtse sbyor )ni/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi skye bo snyed// sangs rgyas mchod pa'i dge la sogs// rnam mang du ni dper mdzad nas// rnam 'phel bcu drug bdag nyid do// bsod nams 'phel ba'i sgo nas te/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi skye bo ji snyed sangs rgyas su gyur pa la 'ga' zhig gis ji srid 'tsho'i bar du mchod pa'i dge ba dang*/ la sogs pas stong gsum gyi skye bo de snyed sangs rgyas su gyur pa la mchod pa gnyis/ 'dzam gling gi sems can ji snyed/ bsam gzugs sogs 'jig rten pa'i phun tshogs/ rgyun zhugs/ phyir 'ong*/ phyir mi 'ong*/ dgra bcom/ rang byang chub/ bla med byang chub la bkod pa'i dge ba bdun/ stong gsum gyi sems can ji snyed de dang de dag tu bkod pa'i dge ba bdun te dge ba bcu drug gi rnam pa mang du bstan pa ni dper mdzad nas/ rtse mo'i mnyam gzhag ni dpe de dang de dag las rnam par 'phel ba'i bsod nams bcu drug gi bdag nyid do/ /mdo gzhung gis gsal lo// gsum pa ( sbyor lam bzod pa'i rtse sbyor )ni/ kun mkhyen nyid gsum chos rnams kyi// yongs su rdzogs pa bla med pa// sems can don yongs mi gtong ba// brtan pa zhes ni mngon par brjod// yum las mi ldog pa brtan pa'i sgo nas te/ kun mkhyen nyid gsum gyi rang bzhin sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi rnam pa ma lus pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i dge ba bla na med pa dang sems can gzhan gyi don yongs su mi gtong bas nyan rang du mi ldog pa nyid dang ldan pas bzod pa'i mnyam gzhag la brtan pa zhes ni mngon par brjod do/ /mdo ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig

ces so// bzhi pa (sbyor lam chos mchog gi rtse sbyor )ni/ gling bzhi pa dang stong dag dang*// stong gnyis gsum dag dper mdzad nas// bsod nams mang po nyid kyis ni// ting 'dzin yongs su bsgrags pa yin// skye med gsum la gnas pa'i rang bzhin te/ gling bzhi pa dang de stong dag ni stong spyi phud de stong la stong gnyis bar ma dang de stong la stong gsum mi mjed de/ de dag skra rtse tsam du bsil ba'i tshad kyang gzung nus pa srid kyi rjes su yi rang dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pa'i bsod nams ni tshad med do zhes bya ba dag dper mdzad nas bsod nams mang po nyid kyi ni chos mchog gi ting nge 'dzin ni yongs su bsgrags pa yin no/ /mdo ni/ de dag gi rjes su yi rang ba dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pa'i bsod nams la ni tshad med do/ /zhes so// mthong lam gyi rtse sbyor/ gnyis pa mthong lam rtse sbyor la gnyis te/ spang bya/ gnyen po'o/ / dang po( spang bya )la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po (mdor bstan pa )la gnyis te/ gzung ba dang*/ 'dzin pa'o// dang po ni/ 'jug pa dang ni ldog pa la// gzung ba'i rnam rtog so sor de// dgu yi bdag nyid ji bzhin yul// min pa'i bdag nyid dag shes bya// 'jug pa'i yul theg chen gyi lam 'bras dang ni ldog pa'i yul theg dman gyi lam 'bras la blang dor du 'dzin pa ni gzung ba'i rnam rtog gnyis so/ /de gnyis so sor yul de'i dbye bas dgu dgu'i bdag nyid du yod la/ 'khrul pa'i rgyu mtshan/ de thams cad kyang gnas tshul ji lta ba bzhin gyi yul la dmigs pa min pas yul can de dag kyang phyin ci log pa'i blo'i bdag nyid dag tu shes par bya'o/ /mdo ni/ gnyis med pa'i 'du shes su mi 'gyur ba de ltar bsngo bar bya'o/ /zhes dang*/ yum rnam par mi rtog pa'o/ /zhes so// gnyis pa ('dzin pa )ni/ so so'i skye bo 'phags dbye bas//

sems can rdzas dang btags yod par// rnam rtog 'dzin pa dag tu 'dod// de dag so sor dgu bdag nyid// gal te gzung don de bzhin med// de dag gang gi 'dzin par 'dod// de ltar de dag 'dzin pa yi// ngo bos stong pa'i mtshan nyid do// so so skye bo dang 'phags pa'i rgyud la yod pa'i dbye bas/ chos kyi bdag gi gdags gzhi sems can te gnyis snang can gyi sems la/ snga mas rdzas su zhen pa dang phyi mas btags yod tsam du zhen pa'i rnam par rtog pa ni 'dzin rtog dag tu 'dod cing de dag kyang so sor yul gyi sgo nas dgu dgu'i bdag nyid do/ /'khrul pa'i don ni/ gal te rdzas btags gang rung du gzung ba'i don yul de med pa bzhin du rtog pa de dag yul gang gis 'dzin par 'dod pa de mi rung ste/ gzung yul don la med na de ltar 'dzin pa 'khrul pa las ma 'das pa'i phyir/ des na de dag kyang 'dzin pa'i rang gis ngo bos stong pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /mdo ni/ gzugs dben pa'i phyir sems can dben pa'o/ /zhes so// gnyis pa (rgyas par bshad pa )la'ang*/ gzung 'dzin gnyis/ dang po (gzung ba )la gnyis te/ 'jug yul/ ldog yul lo/ /dang po ni/ ngo bo nyid dang rigs dang ni// lam ni yang dag 'grub pa dang*// shes pa'i dmigs pa ma 'khrul dang*// mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po dang*// rang gi rtog dang byed pa dang*// de yi las bya'i 'bras bu la// 'jug pa'i phyogs kyi rten can gyi// rnam rtog de ni rnam dgur 'dod// yul byang chub kyi ngo bo nyid dang*/ de la dmigs pa'i theg chen gyi rigs zag med kyi ye shes dang ni/ des lam ni yang dag 'grub pa dang*/ shes pa mnyam gzhag gi dmigs yul kun rdzob med pas ma 'khrul ba dang*/ mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po la 'dor len dang*/ byang sems rang gi rtog pa dang*/ rang don spong bar byed pa dang*/ de'i las gzhan don sgrub pa dang*/ bya ba'i 'bras bu tshogs gnyis la 'jug pa'i phyogs kyi dgu yod pas/

de'i rten can te yul can gyi rnam rtog de ni rnam dgur 'dod/ mdo ni/ gnyen po mi rtog pa'i sgo nas gsungs pa ste/ yum shin tu dben pa'o/ /zhes so// gnyis pa (ldog yul )ni/ srid dang zhi bar ltung ba'i phyir// gas pa dman pa nyid dang ni// yongs su 'dzin pa med pa dang*// lam gyi rnam pa ma tshang dang*// gzhan gyi rkyen gyis 'gro ba dang*// ched du bya ba log pa dang*// nyi tshe ba dang sna tshogs nyid// gnas dang 'jug la rmongs pa dang*// rjes la 'gro zhes bya ba la// rnam rtog dgu yi bdag nyid 'di// ldog pa'i phyogs kyi rten can te// nyan thos la sogs yid las 'byung*// yul srid dang zhi bar lhung ba'i phyir/ nyan rang gi rtogs pa dman pa nyid dang ni/ thabs mkhas kyi yongs su 'dzin pa med pa dang*/ sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i lam gyi rnam pa phal cher ma tshang ba dang*/ slar yang theg chen du rang stobs kyis min par gzhan gyi rkyen gyis 'gro dgos pa dang*/ ched du gnyer bar bya ba'i 'bras bu rnam mkhyen la log pa dang*/ spangs pa ny-i tshe ba dang*/ rtogs pa mtshan 'dzin sna tshogs can nyid dang*/ rnam mkhyen la gnas pa dang de'i sgo nas gzhan don la 'jug pa la rmongs pa dang*/ sbyin sogs lnga sher phyin gyi rjes la 'gro ba zhes bya ba la/ rnam rtog dgu yi bdag nyid 'di/ /ldog pa'i phyogs kyi rten can te/ /nyan thos la sogs yid las 'byung*/ mdo ni/ nyi zlas gling bzhir las byed cing rjes su 'brang ba'i dpes so// gnyis pa 'dzin pa la gnyis te/ rdzas dang*/ btags par 'dzin pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'dzin pa dang ni 'dor ba dang*// yid la byed dang khams rnams ni// gsum po dag dang nyer 'brel dang*// gnas dang mngon par zhen pa dang*// chos kyi dngos po btags pa dang*// chags pa dang ni gnyen po dang*// ji ltar 'dod bzhin 'gro nyams la// 'dzin pa dang por shes par bya// yul gzugs sogs 'dzin pa dang ni 'dor ba dang*/

de dag yid la byed pa dang*/ des na sems sems byung rnams khams rnams ni gsum po dag dang nyer 'brel ba dang*/ gzugs sogs la bden 'dzin gyi gnas pa dang*/ de la mngon par zhen pa dang*/ chos kyi dngos po med pa la rdzas su btags pa dang*/ 'khor gsum la zhen pa'i chags pa dang ni de'i gnyen po rnams la'ang rdzas su 'dzin pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sar ji ltar 'dod bzhin 'gro ba las nyams pa ste/ dgu po rnams la rdzas su dmigs pa'i rtog pa ni 'dzin pa dang por shes par bya'o/ /mdo ni/ yum ni chos gang yang yongs su 'dzin pa'am gtong ba med do/ /zhes so// gnyis pa (btags 'dzin )ni/ ched bzhin nges par mi 'byung dang*// lam la lam min nges 'dzin dang*// 'gag dang bcas pa'i skye ba dang*// dngos po ldan dang mi ldan dang*// gnas dang rigs ni 'jig pa dang*// don du gnyer dang rgyu med dang*// phyir rgol ba ni dmigs pa la// 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gzhan yin no// yul can rang gi ched du dmigs pa bzhin rnam mkhyen du nges par mi 'byung ba dang*/ dman lam la rang lam min par nges par 'dzin pa dang*/ rgyu 'gag pa dang bcas pa'i 'bras bu skye ba dang*/ btags pa'i dngos po ldan pa dang rdzas kyi dngos po mi ldan pa dang*/ des gzugs sogs la gnas pa 'jig pa dang*/ nyan rang gi rigs ni 'jig pa dang*/ phyin drug don du gnyer ba dang*/ don du rgyu lam med pa dang*/ yum spyod pa la phyir rgol ba'i bdud rnams ni btags pa tsam du dmigs pa dgu la 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gzhan yin no/ /mdo ni/ rnam mkhyen nyid gang na ba der lam mnyam pa nyid nas 'gro'o/ /zhes so// gnyis pa gnyen po la gnyis te/ bral 'bras byang chub/ bral byed mthong lam nyid bshad pa'o/ /dang po (bral 'bras byang chub) la gnyis te/ thob pa'i rgyu/ byang chub ngos bzung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ byang chub la gzhan ston pa dang*// de yi rgyu ni yongs gtod dang*//

de thob bar chad med pa'i rgyu// bsod nams mang po'i mtshan nyid do// gnyis zhen gyi dri ma bral byed rang bzhin rnam dag mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rgyu gsum ni/ byang chub thob par 'gyur ba la gzhan lung ston pa dang*/ de'i rgyu sher phyin ni gzhan la yongs su gtod pa dang*/ de thob pa'i bar chad med pa'i rgyu'am lam rang rig rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes dmigs med kyi snying rje dang ldan pas bsod nams mang po'i mtshan nyid can mthong lam rnams so/ /mdo ni/ byang sems de dag ni dka' ba bgyid pa'o/ /zhes so// gnyis pa (byang chub ngos bzung ba )la gsum ste/ dngos kyi don/ de la klan ka spang*/ de sgom tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ dri ma zad dang mi skye ba'i// ye shes byang chub ces brjod de// zad med skye med phyir de dag/ go rim bzhin du shes par bya// dri ma med nges yin par rtogs pa zad pa dang ye shes skye 'gag gnas pa dang bral bar rtogs pa mi skye ba ste/ de gnyis mngon duu gyur pa'i ye shes la byang chub ces brjod de/ chos sku thob pa tsam yin la sgom lam du gnyis snang rim pas 'gags pas chos sku rim pa rdzogs byed do/ /de yang gnas tshul la zhugs te/ yul can nad kyi 'khrul bas yul dung la ser por mthong zhing*/ nad sangs na dkar po nyid mthong mod/ yul dung steng du ser po zad pa dang dkar po gsar skyes med pa ltar/ dri ma zad pa med ye shes skye ba med pa'i phyir/ don de dag go rim bzhin du dpe de ltar shes par bya'o/ /mdo ni/ yum ni ma zad mi zad zad par mi 'gyur/ zhes so// gnyis pa (de la klan ka spang ba )la gnyis te/ dogs pa dang*/ lan no/ dang po ni/ dri ma bden dngos zhig gnyen po gsar skye zhig gis bcom pa yin gyi/ gzhan du na byang chub thob pa'i tha snyad mi rung snyam du dngos smra ba'i blo la 'char ba'o// gnyis pa (lan )ni/ 'gog pa med pa'i rang bzhin la//

mthong zhes bya ba'i lam gyi ni// rnam par rtog rigs ci zhig zad// skye med rnam pa ci zhig thob// gzhan gyi chos rnams kyang yod la// shes bya la yang ston pa yi// sgrib pa zad par brjod pa gang*// de la kho bos mtshar du brtsis// gnas tshul la de lta ma yin te/ dri ma 'gog pa'i rtsol ba med pa'i kun gzhi'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin 'di la/ rang ngo mthong ba zhes bya ba'i lam gyi ni/ spang bya rnam par rtog rigs ci zhig zad par byas shing gsar du skye med kyi rnam pa ci zhig thob par byas pa ma yin te/ gnyid sad pa na rmi lam mi 'byung ba dang mtshungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar thugs rje chen po bstan pa'i mdor/ zad pa gnyen pos zad pa min/ /sngon nas zad pas de phyir zad/ /ces so/ /rgyud blar yang*/ ji ltar sngar bzhin phyis de bzhin/ /'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid do/ /zhes so/ /tshul de las gzhan sgrib byed kyi chos rnams kyang bden par yod par 'dod la/ rang lugs shes bya khas len la yang ston pa sangs rgyas kyi sgrib pa sa bon dang bcas pa zad par yang brjod pa gang 'gal bar smra ba'i grub mtha' de la kho bos mtshar du brtsis zhes thugs khrel ba'o/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ bden grub yin na spong mi nus te/ rtsa sher/ rang bzhin gzhan du 'gyur ba ni/ /nam yang 'thad pa ma yin no/ /zhes bshad pa ltar ro// gsum pa sgom tshul ni/

'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag lta// yang dag mthong nas rnam par grol// theg gsum gyi byang chub la rim 'jug gi dbang du byas na/ nyan thos kyi lta ba/ rang rgyal gyi lta ba/ dbu ma'i lta ba gsum mo/ /dang po (nyan thos kyi lta ba) ni/ phung po'i steng gi bdag 'dzin dang bral bas nyon sgrib las grol ba'o/ /gnyis pa (rang rgyal gyi lta ba )ni/ gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan med par rtogs pas gzung 'dzin rags pa dang bral ba'o// gsum pa (dbu ma'i lta ba )ni/ byang sems kyi gnyis zhen mtha' dag 'gog cing bsgoms pas gnyis snang gi shes pa yang nub par 'gyur bas chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'o/ /de yang*/ yod min med min yod med min/ /gnyis ka'i bdag nyid min pa'ang min/ /mtha' bzhi las ni rnam grol ba/ /de ni dbu ma pa yis rig /ces so// 'di'i don bshad pa la lugs gnyis kyi nang nas thal rang gi dbu ma rang stong smra ba dag gis/ de bzhin nyid la 'dzin pa mi rung ba'i sgo nas bshad de/ de dag gang du gzung yang gnyis 'dzin las ma 'das pas so/ /zhes zer/ rje btsun dang thogs med mched rang lugs kyi gtso bor ni/ de bzhin nyid gnyis snang gi yul du mi 'ong bas de la bden 'dzin byung dogs med kyi/ gzhung 'dis kun rdzob thams cad ri bong gi rwa ltar yod med gnyis ka gnyis min sogs gang du yang med pa de nyid ngo sprod pa'i don yin no/ /rgyud blar/ sems de rang bzhin 'od gsal bas na nyon mongs ngo bo med gzigs pa/ /zhes so// des na snying po dag pa gzhan dbang kun gzhi'i ye shes 'di la dri ma med pa'i phyir bsal bya ci yang med cing thog ma med pa'i dus can yin pas ye shes gsar du bzhag par bya ba cung zad med kyi/ 'o na ji ltar sgom na/ yang dag pa'i don rang sems nyid la rang gis yang dag par lta ba'i tshul gyis bsgom mo/ /de tshe gnyis 'dzin thams cad nub nas blta bya lta byed gnyis med pa'i yang dag pa'i don mngon sum du mthong na mthong lam thob pa yin pas rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/

/mdo sdud par/ skye med zad pa med par shes rab 'di shes te/ /nyi ma sprin med/ ces so/ /lang gshegs las/ sems tsam la ni brten nas su/ /phyi rol don du mi rtog go /snang ba med pa la brten nas/ /sems tsam las ni 'da' bar bya/ /yang dag dmigs pa la brten nas/ /snang ba med las 'da' bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun no// gnyis pa bral byed mthong lam nyid bshad pa la gsum ste/ spang gnyen dngos bar chad med lam*/ gzhi'i gnyen po rnam par grol ba'i lam/ thag sring ba'i gnyen po khyad par gyi lam mo/ /dang po ni/ sbyin pa la sogs re rer ni// de dag phan tshun bsdus pa gang*// skad cig gcig pa'i bzod pa yis// bsdus pa de 'dir mthong ba'i lam// sbyor lam gyi skabs su mthong spangs rnam par sun dbyung nas/ sa bon spong byed ni/ /sbyin pa la sogs pa'i phar phyin re rer ni/ rang rang ma gtogs pa'i phar phyin lnga po de dag phan tshun bsdus pa'i ye shes gang yin pa de mthong lam skad cig ma gcig pa'i bzod pa bzhi yis bsdus pa de 'dir mthong ba'i lam mo/ /mdo ni/ sbyin sogs phar phyin re re la gnas shing gzhan lnga yongs su 'dzin/ zhes so// gnyis pa (gzhi'i gnyen po rnam par grol ba'i lam )ni/ bcu drug pa'i rtogs pa ni dngos yin la shes pa gzhan rnams kyang rjes mthun pa'o// gsum pa (thag sring ba'i gnyen po khyad par gyi lam )ni/ de nas seng ge rnam bsgyings pa'i// ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs nas// rten cing 'brel 'byung lugs mthun dang*// lugs mi mthun la rtog par byed// mthong lam thob pa des na/ bsam gtan dang po nas 'gog pa'i bar 'gog pa nas bsam gtan dang po'i bar te sbyor ba seng ge rnam bsgyings pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rjes thob tu rten cing 'brel 'byung lugs mthun dang lugs mi mthun la rtog par byed do/ /mdo ni/ seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug go

/zhes dang*/ ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed ces so sor rtog go /zhes so// 'dir rten 'brel gyi mtha' dpyad pa la gsum ste/ dbye gzhi/ sgra bshad/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gang zhig yod pa ma mthong med mthong ba// 'di 'dra'i mun nag rnam pa ci zhig kwa/ zhes pa'i gnyis snang ma rig pa nyon mongs can min pa'o/ /'di ni 'khor ba ste ye nas med pas thog mtha' gang yang don la med cing tha snyad du/ thog med gyur kyang mtha' ma dang ldan pa/ /zhes pa ltar ro// gnyis pa (sgra bshad )ni/ rkyen la rten cing rgyu 'bras ma 'chol bar 'byung ba'o// gsum pa (dbye ba) la gnyis te/ so sor dbye ba/ rnam gzhag bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'khrul ngor rgyu 'bras mi zad par 'khor ba ste/ /nyon mongs can gyi ma rig pa la/ mthong spangs dang sgom spangs gnyis/ dang po bden pa la rmongs pa ste drug yid kho na'i 'khor du 'byung ba'o/ /gnyis pa la nyon yid 'khor dang drug yid 'khor du 'byung ba gnyis/ phyi ma la'ang bden pa la rmongs pa dang yul la rmongs pa gnyis/ de las rten 'brel gyi skabs 'dir gsungs pa ni phyi ma ste/ des yang srid 'phen byed kyi kun slong byed pa'i phyir/ 'du byed ni des kun nas bslangs pa'i lus ngag yid kyi las so/ /rnam shes ni las de'i sa bon kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi steng du gnas pa dang de 'bras mngal du nying mtshams sbyar ba'i skabs so/ /ming gzugs ni de nas phung po gzhan bzhi 'grub pa'o/ /skye mched drug ni de rnams so sor dod pa'o//reg pa ni yul dbang rnam shes gsum 'dus nas yul gyi 'gyur ba gcod pa ste/ mig nas yid kyi 'dus reg drug go /tshor ba ni reg pa las sim gdung bar mar myong ba ste lus tshor sems tshor gnyis so/ /sred pa ni tshor ba bde sdug la blang dor du chags pa ste khams gsum la sred pa gsum mo/ /len pa ni de dag 'tshol ba la 'dun pa ste/

'dod yon la chags pa lta log re gnyis tshul khrims brtul zhugs la rlom pa bdag la chags pa ste nyer len bzhi'o/ /srid pa ni de gnyis kyi kun gzhi'i steng gi las kyi sa bon sad nas nus pa mthu can du gyur pa ste/ sngon dus kyi srid pa skye srid 'chi srid bar srid bzhi'o//skye ba ni yang skye gnas su 'jug pa nas tshor ba'i bar te sgo nga mngal drod gsher rdzus skyes bzhi'o/ /rga shi ni tshe dbang po gzugs stobs dran pa shes rab bde ba 'gyur ba dang dus dang dus min du shi ba'o// gnyis pa (rnam gzhag bstan pa )ni/ ma rig 'gag pa nas rga shi 'gags pa'i bar rnam byang g-i rten 'brel lo/ /yan lag bcu gnyis po 'di ni mngal skyes kyi dbang du byas pa yin la/ de las dang po gnyis tshe sngon/ tha ma gnyis tshe phyi ma/ lhag ma rnams da ltar gyi skabs yin la/ bsdu na/ dang po brgyad pa dgu nyon mongs/ /gnyis pa bcu pa las yin te/ /lhag ma bdun ni sdug bsngal yin/ /zhes pa ltar ro// sgom lam gyi rtse sbyor/ gsum pa sgom lam rtse sbyor la gsum ste/ gnyen po'i sgom lam/ spang bya rtog pa/ brten pa yon tan no/ /dang po (gnyen po'i sgom lam )la gnyis te/ spyi'i don dang*/ gzhung don no/ /dang po la gnyis te/ gnyen po thod rgal gyi snyoms 'jug /des spang bya spong tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ sgom spangs kyi sa bon mgo gnon par byed pa'i sbyor ba seṅge rnam bsgyings pa sngon du song nas/ drungs 'byin byed bar chad med lam dngos gzhi thod rgal la chung ngu ni sgom tshul seṅge rnam bsgyings dang 'dra la/ 'bring ni bsam gtan dang po las langs nas 'gog par 'jug de nas gnyis par te de ltar mthar gnas brgyad dang 'gog pa spel zhing 'gog pa las srid rtse'i sems kyis ldang zhing langs rjes su mnyam bzhag las sad par 'gyur la/ de'i sems tha ma gnyis gcig tu byas pa'i gnas bcu bdun/

chen po ni slar 'gog par zhugs de nas rjes thob tu langs de nas srid rtse yang langs de ltar snyoms 'jug dgu dang rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu spel ba bco brgyad/ yar 'ong phye na sum cu rtsa drug go /thod rgal chung 'bring chen po re rer yang nang gses chung 'bring chen po gsum gsum phye ba ni sa re re'o/ /de'i sbyor ba seṅge rnam bsgyings pa yang de ltar grangs mnyam du 'gyur zhing snyoms 'jug de dag la ni brten pa tsam yin gyi/ ngo bo ni skabs gnyis par bstan pa'i sgrub pa sgom lam nyid do// gnyis pa (des spang bya spong tshul )ni/ glo bur rnam dag la sgrib byed gnyis snang can dang des bskyed pa'i gzung 'dzin la btags pa tsam du zhen pa ci rigs yul gyis dgu mtshan bzhir phye ba'i re re la che 'bring chung ngu*/ de re rer yang che 'bring chung gsum gsum du phye ba rnams spong ngo*// gnyis pa gzhung don ni/ 'gog dang bcas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgur// rnam pa gnyis su song 'ongs nas// 'dod par gtogs pa'i rnam par shes// mnyam bzhag min pa'i mtshams bzung ste// thod rgal du ni snyoms 'jug pa// gcig dang gnyis gsum bzhi dang lnga// drug dang bdun dang brgyad rgal nas// 'gog pa'i bar du mi 'drar 'gro/ thod rgal chung ngu ni 'gog dang bcas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgur/ rnam pa gnyis su yar song dang phyir 'ongs nas so/ /chen po ni 'dod par gtogs pa'i rnam par shes pa mnyam bzhag min pa rjes thob kyi mtshams bzung can te/ thod rgal du ni snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshul mthar gnas brgyad kyi gcig dang gnyis gsum bzhi dang lnga/ drug dang bdun dang brgyad la rjes thob dang spel te rgal nas 'gog par 'jug pa de'i bar du mnyam rjes mi 'dra ba spel mar 'gro ba'o/ /'bring ni gzhung gis ma bstan no/ /mdo ni/ thod rgal gyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug go /zhes so// gnyis pa spang bya rtog pa la/

gzung 'dzin gnyis/ dang po (gzung ba )la 'jug ldog gnyis/ dang po ('jug yul )ni/ mdor bsdus rgyas dang sangs rgyas kyis// btang bas yongs su ma bzung dang*// dus gsum yon tan med pa dang*// legs pa'i lam ni rnam gsum la// gzung ba'i rnam rtog 'di gcig ste// sbyor ba'i rnam pa'i spyod yul can// yul gnyis med kyi ye shes mdor bsdus dang chos can spyi'i mtshan nyid rgyas pa dang yum la mi slob pa sangs rgyas kyis btang bas yongs su ma bzung yang slob ma rnams ma btang bas yongs su bzung ba dang*/ yum la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i yon tan med 'dzin las zlog ste dus gsum sangs rgyas 'byung bar rtog pa gsum dang*/ legs pa'i lam ni mos spyod ma dag sa dag sa rnam pa gsum la 'jug byar zhen pa'i rtog pa dgu ni/ gzung ba'i rnam rtog 'di la gnyis yod pa'i dang po gcig ste/ yum la sbyor ba'i dus kyi yul can rnam pa dang spyod pa'i yul yin pas btags pa tsam gyi yul yul can no/ /mdo ni/ gzugs kyi de bzhin nyid gang zhe na chos thams cad kyi mdo dang rgyas par byed do/ /zhes so// gnyis pa (ldog yul )ni/ gnyis pa sems dang sems byung rnams// 'jug pa'i yun can yin bzhed de// sems mi skye dang byang chub kyi// snying po yid la mi byed dang*// theg pa dman pa yid byed dang*// rdzogs pa'i byang chub yid mi byed// sgom dang sgom pa med pa dang*// de dag las ni bzlog nyid dang*// ji bzhin don min rnam rtog pa// sgom pa'i lam la shes par bya// gnyis su snang ba can gyi sems dang sems byung rnams kyang yul la 'jug pa'i yul can gyi rtog pa yin pas spang bya'i gtso bo yin par bcom ldan 'das bzhed cing*/ de la yul byang chub kyi sems mi bskyed pa dang byang chub kyi snying po yum yid la mi byed pa dang theg pa dman pa yid la byed pa dang chos can rdzogs pa'i byang chub yid la mi byed pa dang rab tu sgom pas rnam mkhyen thob bam snyam pa dang*/

sgom pa med pas thob bam snyam pa dang*/ de dag las ni ldog pa sgoms kyang bsgoms la ma bsgoms kyang ma bsgoms pas thob bam snyam pa dang*/ sgoms pa yang min mi sgom pa yang min pas thob bam snyam pa nyid dang*/ de bzhin nyid kun gzhi'i ye shes la gnas tshul ji lta ba bzhin gyi don min nam snyam pa'i sems byung gi rnam rtog 'phro ba la skyon can du lta ba'i rnam par rtog pa dgu ni/ sgom pa'i lam la gnas pa'i spang byar shes par bya'o/ /ci nas kyang sems dang sems las byung ba'i chos rnams mi rgyu ba de ltar sher phyin la spyad sgrub bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes so// gnyis pa ('dzin pa )la/ btags pa dang*/ 'dogs pa'i rgyu gnyis/ dang po ni/ sems can btags pa'i spyod yul dang*// chos btags pa dang stong min nyid// chags dang rab 'byed bdag nyid dang*// dngos por byed dang theg gsum dang*// yon ni dag pa ma yin dang*// spyod pa rnam par 'khrugs pa la// 'dzin par byed pa dang por de// shes par bya ba bsgrags pa yin// yul chos bdag gi gdags gzhi sems can rnam shes btags pa tsam du 'dzin pa'i spyod yul can dang*/ de la snang ba'i chos rnams btags pa dang stong nyid min par kun rdzob snang tsam yod par zhen pa nyid dang*/ dmigs yul la chags pa dang chos rnams shes rab kyis rab tu 'byed pa'i bdag nyid dang dngos por 'du byed pa'i zhen pa dang*/ theg gsum so sor zhen pa dang yum la mi gzhol ba yon tan gyi gnas ni dag pa yin pa dang*/ 'khor gsum du rtog pas sbyin sogs spyod pa rnam par 'khrugs pa ste/ de rnams la btags pa tsam du zhen cing 'dzin par byed pa ni 'dzin rtog dang por de ni shes par bya bar bsgrags pa yin no/ /gang zag mi dmigs na ji ltar gdags par bya de ltar chos thams cad du ma btags pas rnam mkhyen thob par 'gyur/ zhes so// gnyis pa ('dogs pa'i rgyu )ni/ sems can btags dang de rgyu yi//

yul can de yis rnam 'joms pas// sgom pa'i lam dang 'brel ba yi// mi mthun phyogs gzhan rnam pa dgu/ bdag nyid ji bzhin kun mkhyen ni// gsum gyi sgrib pa rnam gsum dang*// zhi lam de bzhin nyid sogs dang*// mtshungs par ldan dang mi ldan dang*// mi mnyam sdug bsngal la sogs dang*// nyon mongs rnams kyi rang bzhin dang*// gnyis su med la kun rmongs la// rnam par rtog pa tha mar bzhed// sems can chos bdag tu btags pa dang 'dogs pa de'i gzhi'am rgyu'i yul can gnyis snang gi shes pa sgom lam de'i rnam par 'joms pas gnyen po sgom pa'i lam dang spang byar 'brel ba'i mi mthun phyogs 'dzin rtog snga ma las gzhan rnam pa dgu 'chad de zhes mgo 'dren pa'o// dgu ni/ yul mkhyen gsum gyis spangs pa'i bdag nyid ji lta ba bzhin du kun mkhyen ni gsum gyi ngo bo rnam par dag pa la sgrib pa rnam pa gsum dang theg gsum gyi zhi ba'i lam dang chos nyid de bzhin nyid sogs dang yum mtshungs par ldan pa dang mi ldan pa dang spangs rtogs mi mnyam pa dang*/ sdug bsngal la sogs bden pa bzhi dang*/ nyon mongs rnams kyi rang bzhin zad skye med pa dang gzung 'dzin gnyis su med pa'i don la kun tu rmongs pa rnams la rnam par rtog pa ni 'dzin rtog mtha' mar bzhed do/ /rnam mkhyen nyid ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi yin no/ /zhes so//

gsum pa brten pa yon tan ni/ yams nad 'di rnams zad nas ni// yun ring lon nas dbugs phyin ltar// rnam pa kun tu 'gro ba yi// bde sgrub yon tan phun tshogs kun// rgya mtsho che la chu bo bzhin// 'bras bu mchog gis spa ba yi// sems dpa' chen po de la ni// rnam pa kun tu bsten par byed// yams nad dang 'dra ba'i shes sgrib 'di rnams sman dang 'dra ba'i spros med ye shes kyis zad par byas nas spangs pa de ni nad kyi ngal dub yun ring lon nas de las grol bas dbugs phyin zhing bde ba thob pa ltar du gyur pas de lta'i byang sems la rnam pa kun tu 'gro ba'i gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba sgrub pa'i yon tan phun tshogs zad med kun rgya mtsho che la chu bo 'bab pa bzhin rgyun mi chad du 'byung zhing der ma zad 'bras bu rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog thob pa dag gis mdzes shing dpa' ba'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po de la ni rnam pa kun tu bsten par byed pa ste/ byang sems de ni myur du 'tshang rgya'o/ /mdo ni/ lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bu ltar sems can thams cad la nye bar 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes so// bar chad med lam gyi rtse sbyor/ bzhi pa bar chad med lam gyi rtse sbyor la gnyis te/ bar chad med rtse dngos/ lam gyi dmigs rnams la klan ka bsal ba'o/ /dang po ni/ stong gsum skye bo nyan thos dang*// bse ru'i rtogs pa phun tshogs dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i skyon med la// bkod pa'i dge ba dper mdzad nas// bsod nams mang po nyid kyis ni// sangs rgyas nyid kyi bar med de// bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin// de ni rnam pa kun mkhyen nyid// gnas ngan len gyi dri ma yang dag min rtog gi sa bon chags thogs kyi sgrib pa gzhom byed rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin rgyun mtha'i ye shes yin la de yang dpes bstan pa/ bar chad med pa'i lam gyi ting nge 'dzin ni/

stong gsum gyi skye bo thams cad nyan thos kyi rtogs pa dang rang rgyal bse ru lta bu'i rtogs pa phun tshogs dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa skyon med pa sa dang po la bkod pa'i dge ba rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin 'di'i brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro zhes dper mdzad nas bsod nams mang po nyid kyis ni bsgrubs pa'i rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin 'di dang sangs rgyas nyid kyi bar na sgrib pas chod pa med de de'i phyir bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin de ni rnam pa kun mkhyen pa'i ye shes nyid yin no/ /mdo ni/ byang sems byang chub tu zhugs pa'i bsod nams kyi brgya'i char yang mi 'gro/ zhes so// gnyis pa (lam gyi dmigs rnams la klan ka bsal ba )la gnyis te/ dmigs rnam bshad pa/ de la log rtog bsal ba'o/ /dang po (dmigs rnam bshad pa )la gnyis te/ spyir rgyu rkyen gyi rnam gzhag gzhung don bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyu ni 'bras bu nye bar len cing 'bras bu'i ngo bo bskyed pa ste/ dbye na rang las gzhan pa 'bras bu'i ngo bo bskyed pa byed rgyu/ tshogs pa gcig pa'i 'byung bzhi phan tshun rgyu 'bras lta bu lhan cig 'byung ba'i rgyu/ spang bya rang rigs dang sa mtshungs lta bu'i 'dra ba bskyed pa skal mnyam gyi rgyu/ gtso sems dang rang 'khor sems byung phan tshun phan 'dogs pa mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu/ nyon mongs can phyi ma rnams rang sa'i kun 'gro snga mas bskyed pa kun 'gro'i rgyu/ mi dge ba dang dge ba zag bcas ni rnam smin gyi rgyu ste drug go /rkyen ni 'bras bu'i khyad par bskyed pa ste/ dbye na/ rgyu tha ma lnga rgyu'i rkyen/ sems kyi skad cig snga ma ni phyi ma'i de ma thag rkyen/ gzugs sogs yul rnams rnam shes kyi dmigs rkyen/ byed rgyu ni bdag rkyen te bzhi'o/ /des na 'jim pas bum pa bskyed pa ltar rgyu rkyen mtshungs pa'ang yod do//

gnyis pa (gzhung don bshad pa )ni/ 'di yi dmigs pa dngos med de// bdag po dran pa yin par bzhed// rnam pa zhi nyid theg chen 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes 'di'i dmigs pa ni/ skye 'gag sogs kun rdzob pa'i dngos po med pa ste/ bdag po ni sgom pa'i shes rab bam dran pa yin par bzhed la rnam pa ni spros mtshan zhi ba rang rig ye shes nyid yin no/ /de dag ni tha snyad tsam du bzhag pa ste don du de bzhin nyid la rgyu rkyen sogs bzhag tu med pa'i phyir/ mdo ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi dmigs pa ni dngos po med pa'o/ /zhes so// log par sgrub pa/ gnyis pa de la log rtog bsal ba la gnyis te/ log rtog 'byung tshul/ de bsal tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ 'di la ni// rab tu smra rnams brgyud mar rgol// bcom ldan 'das kyis lam gsungs pa 'di la ni/ de kho na nyid don dam pa'i rang bzhin las kun rdzob kyi rten 'brel sna tshogs zad med du 'char ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul blor m-i shong ba'i rtog ge rab tu smra ba rnams kyis kun rdzob kyi dngos po rnams med na/ lam gyis dmigs pa nas yum sgom pa'i bar mi 'thad do zhes brgyud mar rgol bar 'gyur ro/ / mdor/ rab 'byor gyis dri ba'i sgo nas klan ka bcu drug dang*/ ston pas de dag gi lan gsungs shing*/ de'i tshe dngos su rgol ba med kyang dogs slongs lta bu'o// gnyis pa (de bsal tshul )ni/ dmigs pa 'thad dang de yi ni// ngo bo nyid nges gzung ba dang*// rnam kun mkhyen nyid ye shes dang*// dam pa'i don dang kun rdzob dang*// sbyor dang dkon mchog gsum po dang*// thabs bcas thub pa'i rtogs pa dang*// phyin ci log ni lam bcas dang*// gnyen po mi mthun phyogs dag dang*// mtshan nyid dang ni sgom pa la// smra ba rnams kyi log rtog pa// rnam pa kun mkhyen nyid brten can// rnam pa bcu drug dag tu bzhed//

'dus byas kyi chos rnams 'khrul snang yin pa'i phyir 'phags chen gyi mnyam bzhag gi dmigs pa dngos med 'thad pa dang*/ chos dbyings las gzhan pa'i chos med pa'i phyir ye shes de'i ni ngo bo dngos med nyid du nges par gzung ba 'thad pa dang*/ chos nyid de chos thams cad kyi gshis la 'jug pa'i phyir des rnam pa kun mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes su 'thad pa dang*/ phan tshun thabs shes su 'gyur ba'i phyir dam pa'i don gyi bden pa dang kun rdzob gyi bden pa 'thad pa dang*/ de ni rtsa sher/ tha snyad la ni ma brten par// dam pa'i don ni rtogs mi 'gyur// zhes pa lta bu'o/ /byang chub kyi don du spyod pa'i phyir phyin drug la sbyor ba 'thad pa dang*/ yang dag pa'i don rtogs pa'i phyir sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang*/ de bzhin nyid byang chub yin pa'i phyir chos dkon mchog dang*/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis byang chub la slob pa'i phyir dge 'dun dkon mchog ste gsum po 'thad pa dang*/ 'khor gsum mi dmigs par 'jug pa'i phyir thabs mkhas dang bcas pa 'thad pa dang*/ spros pa rnams med nges su gzigs pa'i phyir thub pa'i rtogs pa 'thad pa dang*/ gzugs sogs rtag mi rtag gang du gzung yang 'dzin pa yin pas phyin ci log ni 'thad pa dang*/ lam thams cad la slob pa'i phyir rnam mkhyen thob byed kyi lam bcas 'thad pa dang*/ kun rdzob tu blang dor 'byung ba'i phyir gnyen po 'thad pa dang*/ spang bya mi mthun phyogs dag 'thad pa dang*/ thams cad chos dbyings su ro gcig pa'i phyir mtshan nyid 'thad pa dang ni gang yang yid la mi byed pa sgom pa yin pa'i phyir yum sgom pa 'thad pa ste/ de dag la 'khrul par smra ba rnams kyi log par rtog pa rnam pa kun mkhyen nyid la brten nas 'byung ba can gyi log lta rnam pa bcu drug bsal ba dag tu bzhed do// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa las skabs lnga pa'o//
// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa las skabs lnga pa'i 'grel pa'o// //
